name: google-calendar
description: Manage Google Calendar events: list upcoming schedule, create events, check what's on a specific date.
skillSummary: Manage Google Calendar events. Create new events, list upcoming schedule, and check what's happening on specific dates or tomorrow.

tools.name: google-calendar.list-events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events. Can filter by date range.

date.description: Date to check (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Use 'tomorrow' or a specific date.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default 1). Use 7 for a week view.

startTime.description: Start time (HH:MM, 24h format). Omit for all-day event.

endTime.description: End time (HH:MM, 24h format). Defaults to 1 hour after start.

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses

tools.name: google-calendar.check-schedule
tools.description: Check if a specific time slot is free or busy.

tools.name: google-calendar.setup-oauth
tools.description: Start the OAuth2 setup flow to connect Google Calendar. Call this if Google Calendar is not yet authorized.
